title: "All 32 Teams, Sorted by What They Actually Are"

page-layout: full

::: {.lead}
Standings sort teams by results. This page sorts them by *profile* &mdash; the combination of passing efficiency and defensive suppression that the win model says explains roughly three quarters of win variation. Teams sitting in the same group played fundamentally similar football in 2025, whatever their records say.
:::
